description_en: Call this operation to request O&M tokens for bastions or databases, which allows you to manage assets
description_zh: 您可以通过该接口申请主机或数据库运维令牌，并通过运维令牌运维资产
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost generate-asset-operation-token --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --asset-type Host --asset-id 11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateAssetOperationToken

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要申请运维令牌操作所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host instance.

For more information about region IDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the asset for which you want to generate an O\&M token. Valid values:

Host

Database
parameters.help_zh:
指定要申请令牌的资产类型。取值：
Host：主机。
Database：数据库
parameters.name: asset_type

parameters.help_zh: 需要申请运维令牌的资产ID
parameters.name: asset_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset account.

You must specify at least one of `AssetAccountId` and `AssetAccountName`. If you specify both parameters, `AssetAccountId` is used
parameters.help_zh:
申请运维令牌的资产账户ID。
AssetAccountId和AssetAccountName需要至少指定一个，当同时指定时，优先使用AssetAccountId
parameters.name: asset_account_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the asset account. If this parameter specifies a custom account, you must enter the actual account name.

If you specify both `AssetAccountId` and `AssetAccountName`, `AssetAccountId` is used
parameters.help_zh:
主机账号名，当为自定义账号时，填写真实账户名。

当AssetAccountId和AssetAccountName同时指定时，优先使用AssetAccountId
parameters.name: asset_account_name

parameters.help_en: The password that is encoded in Base64. This parameter is required if you want to generate an O\&M token for a custom account
parameters.help_zh: base64后的密码。当为自定义账号申请运维令牌时必填
parameters.name: asset_account_password

parameters.help_en:
The protocol that is used to connect to the asset. Valid values:

SSH

RDP

Oracle

PostgreSQL

MySQL

SQLServer

This parameter is required if you want to generate an O\&M token for a custom account
parameters.help_zh:
协议名称。取值：

SSH
RDP
Oracle
PostgreSQL
MySQL
SQLServer

当为自定义账号申请运维令牌时必填
parameters.name: asset_account_protocol_name

parameters.help_en:
The O\&M mode. Valid values:

WebToken: generates an O\&M token.

Sso: logs on to the client.

This parameter is supported only by bastion hosts of V3.2.44 or later. If you do not specify this parameter, WebToken is used
parameters.help_zh:
运维登录方式。取值：
WebToken：获取运维令牌。
Sso：本地客户端登录。
仅支持V3.2.44及以上版本使用，为空时默认取值为WebToken
parameters.name: operation_mode

parameters.help_en:
The logon attribute. This parameter is required if you set OperationMode to Sso and use a custom Oracle account. Valid values:

SERVICENAME

SID

This parameter is supported only by bastion hosts of V3.2.44 or later
parameters.help_zh:
登录属性，当OperationMode为Sso且账户为Oracle类型自定义账户时必须指定，取值：
SERVICENAME
SID
仅支持V3.2.44及以上版本使用
parameters.name: login_attribute

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database. This parameter is required for a custom account if you set OperationMode to Sso and AssetAccountProtocolName to PostgreSQL or Oracle.

This parameter is supported only by bastion hosts of V3.2.44 or later
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名。当OperationMode为Sso且AssetAccountProtocolName为PostgreSQL或Oracle，且为自定义账户时，DatabaseSchema为必填。
仅支持V3.2.44及以上版本使用
parameters.name: database_schema

parameters.help_en:
The type of the client that you want to use for O\&M on a Linux asset. This parameter is required if you set OperationMode to Sso and the asset protocol to SSH. Valid values:

ssh: opens a client that supports the SSH protocol to perform O\&M with SSH permissions.

sftp: opens a client that supports the SFTP protocol to perform O\&M with SFTP permissions.

This parameter is supported only by bastion hosts of V3.2.44 or later
parameters.help_zh:
linux资产运维需打开的本地客户端类型。当OperationMode为Sso且资产协议为SSH时必传。取值：
ssh：打开SSH协议客户端，以SSH权限进行运维。
sftp：打开SFTP协议客户端，以SFTP权限进行运维。
仅支持V3.2.44及以上版本使用
parameters.name: sso_client

parameters.help_en: The remarks for the logon. This parameter is required if your administrator enables logon remarks in the control policy
parameters.help_zh: 登录备注。当管理员在控制策略中开启了登录备注时为必填
parameters.name: operation_note

CountLeft.description_en: The number of remaining uses for the token
CountLeft.description_zh: 运维令牌剩余可使用的次数

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the token. This value is a UNIX timestamp
ExpireTime.description_zh: 运维令牌过期时间。时间戳格式

HasCountLimit.description_en: Indicates whether the token has a use limit

MaxRenewCount.description_en: The maximum number of times the token can be renewed. A value of 0 indicates that the token cannot be renewed
MaxRenewCount.description_zh: 最大续期次数，0表示不可续期

RenewCount.description_en: The number of times the token has been renewed

Token.description_en: The O\&M token that is requested

TokenId.description_en: The ID of the O\&M token

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
